title: FlexFetch
description: optionledger.flex_fetch r1: one Flex request pair (one window of one query of one login) with its outcome and counts; insert only. No token and no account number is stored.

login.description: Name of the login of flex.toml.

query_id.description: Flex query id, digits, as text.

started_at.description: Instant the request pair started, UTC.

finished_at.description: Instant the request pair finished, UTC.

status.description: ok: the report was parsed and stored; failed: the window failed and nothing but this record was stored.

error_kind.description: Kind of the error when failed, for example network or flex_error; empty when ok.

error_code.description: Flex error code as text when the service gave one; empty otherwise.

raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the report, 64 lower-case hex digits; empty when no report arrived. The report itself is not kept.

statements.description: Number of statements in the report.

statements_unmapped.description: Statements of an account the allow-list does not map; not stored.

rows_parsed.description: Trade rows parsed from mapped statements.

rows_revised.description: Rows stored as a later revision.

rows_unchanged.description: Rows equal to the latest stored revision, not written.
